mike_support: Heads-up — TandemHealth (org_id=tandem-882) is hitting 403s on embed provisioning after a key rotation. Customer in UAT, blocked from completing integration. Renewal touchpoint in ~3 weeks, this is a P1 from Support.

mike_support: Quick repro info: POST /v1/keys/validate -> 403, response body says 'invalid key set'. They rotated via UI earlier today. Request-id: r-0a7f3c.

emma_csm: Ack. Thanks for raising. Can you paste the full request headers (redact auth tokens) and the timestamp of the rotation? @sara_cs I'm looping you for comms and renewal risk assessment. :eyes:

mike_support: Rotation timestamp 2026-03-21T15:12:03Z. Headers (redacted):
```
Authorization: REDACTED
X-Org-ID: tandem-882
X-Request-ID: r-0a7f3c
Content-Type: application/json
```

sara_cs: Thanks — will draft a short customer note. We should avoid alarming language. Plan: confirm ETA for fix, offer temporary workaround (revert to previous key if possible), propose 1:1 enablement session. I'll prepare message template and post after engineering estimate.

anish_se: Likely cause — key rotation created a new KMS alias but provisioning worker still references old key id in cache. Quick check: can you run `GET /internal/keys?org=tandem-882` and share response? I can push a cache flush if confirmed. :wrench:

mike_support: Ran the internal call, returned both keys; worker is referencing key id `key-old-7b`. New key id `key-new-2f` present but not active.

oncall_bot: Incident created INC-2026-03121 (priority=P1) — assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

anish_se: I'll trigger a targeted cache flush for that org and monitor. ETA ~15–20m. If flush fixes provisioning, we can advise customer to retry.

emma_csm: Great. Sara, if flush succeeds, can we offer a short rollback guide & scheduled enablement slot today? If it fails, we escalate to a hotfix and ETA + comms.

sara_cs: Yep — draft ready in #templates; will tailor copy. Proposed customer message: "We identified an internal cache mismatch after your key rotation. We're applying a fix and will confirm when provisioning works; temporary workaround is to reissue the previous key or wait ~20 minutes while we flush caches. We're available for a 30m enablement call to finish setup. Apologies for the interruption. — Sara (Redwood)" :white_check_mark:

mike_support: Cache flush done at 1767032400. Customer retried at 1767032460 — provisioning succeeded. They completed UAT flow.

emma_csm: Excellent. Sara, please send the tailored note and log the incident in the account record with outcome and remediation steps. Also mark renewal as 'monitor — short-term risk mitigated' and flag for a follow-up enablement within 72 hours.

sara_cs: Message sent to TandemHealth (copied below). I'll update the CS playbook and create a renewal touch reminder.

sara_cs: "Hi Team — quick update: after your key rotation we saw a short-lived internal cache mismatch that prevented provisioning. We applied a targeted cache flush and confirmed provisioning now succeeds. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through verification steps and confirm your production roll-out. Apologies for the interruption. — Sara (Redwood)" :white_check_mark:

mike_support: Closing the support ticket. Adding notes: cause=cached-old-key, remediation=cache-flush, followup=enablement-call, renewal_risk=low.

emma_csm: Thanks everyone. Good cross-team triage — keep an eye on similar rotations for the next 48h. :triangular_flag_on_post:

sara_cs: I'll add a checklist item to the onboarding doc: post-rotation health-check for provisioning APIs.
